identified_issues: Breaker BKR_512 was actuated without an approved, pre-authorized Switching Order registered in DISPATCH_EMS prior to physical switching, violating Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.1.
Physical maintenance switching executed without prior authorization constitutes an unauthorized line disconnection under Section 4.2.3.
Retrospective submission of ticket SO-2026-8812 (EMS_LOG_9941) at 16:12:15Z occurred 2 minutes and 13 seconds post-switching and cannot cure an unapproved switching action under Section 4.2.3.
evidence: DISPATCH_EMS registry log at 2026-10-06T15:45:00.000Z and 15:50:00.000Z records 'No switching order on file for BKR_512' and 'Pre-authorization status: NONE'.
RELAY_SEL_451 event log records physical manual trip actuation and contact status transition CLOSED -> OPEN at 2026-10-06T16:10:02.100Z-145Z.

DISPATCH_EMS completion log EMS_LOG_9941 at 2026-10-06T16:12:15.000Z confirms 'Reference Order: NONE (unapproved retrospective request SO-2026-8812 created 2m 13s post-switching)' and 'Status: RETROSPECTIVE_UNAUTHORIZED'.
recommended_action: Uphold the compliance infraction notice and mark the operation as FAIL. Issue a formal safety and operational non-compliance report to field maintenance supervision at SUBSTATION_NORTH_14. Enforce mandatory interlocking controls preventing manual feeder de-energization without confirmed dispatch authorization, and retrain personnel on Section 4.2 pre-authorization switching order protocols.
